high_level_description: This image depicts a dramatic and apocalyptic scene set against the backdrop of space. The central focus is on a massive, fiery object that resembles a large asteroid or comet, emitting intense orange and yellow flames and glowing embers. This celestial body appears to be breaking apart, with smaller fragments falling away from it, creating a sense of impending doom. The setting is outer space, characterized by the vastness of the black void and scattered stars, which add to the ominous atmosphere.
